focus: Past tense plural versus female singular food-giving
englishPrompt: They gave food to the boy.
source: Owner directly supplied in response to Lesson 13 prompt

comparisonWithLesson12.englishPrompt: She gave food to the boy.

attestedObservations: Both owner-supplied examples have the order subject, giving form, khean, recipient expression.
The subject spellings differ: Team (English she) versus Teamov (English they).
The past giving spellings differ: deut versus deout.
The recipient spellings differ: ladkaess versus laedkaess. Their different spellings should not be silently standardized.
The Lesson 13 original has two spaces between deout and khean; Lesson 12 original ends with a space.
